::: {.text-center}
# NCURA Regional Conference Workshop
:::

## Workshop Overview

Welcome to the NCURA Regional Conference Workshop! This page contains resources and information for attendees participating in the Vandalizer workshop.

Please click the following link to access the workshop instance. Each instance will be available for the next 4 days for you to experiment. To begin, create an account and sign in.

::: {.callout-warning}
**Important**: These instances run on University of Idaho infrastructure and access cloud services. **Please do not upload sensitive information.**
:::

---

## Test Files

The following test files are provided to allow for low-risk experimentation with the Vandalizer system:

1. [Sample NOFO](https://github.com/nate-layman/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_NOFO.pdf){download="Sample_NOFO.pdf"}
2. [Sample Grant](https://github.com/nate-layman/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Grant.pdf){download="Sample_Grant.pdf"}
3. [Sample Budget](https://github.com/nate-layman/vandalizer-manual/raw/main/test-files/Sample_Budget.xlsx){download="Sample_Budget.xlsx"}
4. [Sample RFA]()
5. [Sample FOA]()
6. [Sample Federal Award Notice]()
7. [Award Notices/Agreements]()

## Sample Workflows

Once you've signed in, you can add the following test workflows to your workspace by clicking the links below. Each workflow demonstrates different capabilities of Vandalizer:

1. **[RFA Checklist Maker](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fc38476292df6997bb5c){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: RFA
   - Output: A structured checklist with key information extracted from an RFA

2. **[Award Notice Compliance Analysis](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fde8476292df6997bb69){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notices
   - Output: A post-award summary that synthesizes all compliance terms and financial requirements into a single, structured 'Compliance & Financial Overview' document

3. **[Federal Financial Report (FFR) Requirements](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fe56476292df6997bb6f){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notices
   - Output: An actionable guide that isolates all FFR and financial reporting obligations

4. **[Subaward Summary Generator](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906fec5476292df6997bb74){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notice
   - Output: An actionable guide that isolates all FFR and financial reporting obligations, detailing submission schedules, systems, required data, and compliance rules

5. **[Prior Approval Requirements Tracking Summary](https://ncura1.insight.uidaho.edu/workflows/duplicate/6906ff64476292df6997bb7e){target="_blank"}**
   - Input: Federal Award Notice
   - Output: A comprehensive tracking summary that isolates prior approval requirements
